hero.title: DELIVERY
hero.logline: August 2020. Pandemic lockdown. Stimulus checks have dried up, and food deliverers are no longer essential workers: *they're expendable slaves.* One deliverer gets an order from a suspicious restaurant.

film.label: The Film
film.heading:
One night.
One order.
film.p1: **DELIVERY is a single night's ride through a city on pause**, told from the saddle of the one worker the lockdown forgot to protect. Empty streets, a silent canal, and an address in a wealthy neighborhood where no restaurant should be.
film.p2: Nearly wordless, built on atmosphere and sound, the film revisits the pandemic from street level: not the headlines, but the man pedaling between them, and what he's willing to carry to keep his family fed.
film.p3: The short is the first door into a larger universe: a feature film set in the same world is in development.

tone.label: The Tone
tone.text: The ride is hypnotic: empty streets, sodium light, a city that belongs to one rider. Then a door opens and the film changes gear. Overlapping voices, too many screens, a deal nobody names. Calm outside. Fever inside. Ask us for the script.

team.label: The Team
team.heading: Made in Montréal
team.intro: An independent collaboration. No studio, no funding, no favors owed. A crew of working professionals building a festival short on craft and goodwill.

members.name: Kiril Shmidov
members.bio: Kiril Shmidov is an award-winning filmmaker and producer with a decade-long footprint in high-end advertising, directing campaigns for global brands including Lancôme, Ford, and GSK. His aesthetic is anchored in technical precision: a clinical focus on the friction between objective truth and narrative construction.

members.name: Patrick Saad
members.bio: Independent producer (L'inis 2023, Louise-Spickler excellence scholarship) with 15+ years in video production. Credits include *Walter* (Fantasia 2025), *Mes plus beaux jours* and *Hôtel Beyrouth*.

members.name: Danik Bartolini
members.bio: Montréal cinematographer and director with a story-first visual signature. His work spans film (*Walter*, *Prospect*) and commercial work for The North Face, Jordan and UFC.

crew.label: Crew Call
crew.heading: We're building a crew
crew.fr: On cherche : 1er assistant réal · direction artistique / costumes · maquillage · dir. de production · assistant de production
crew.pitch: We spend our careers enslaved to clients. This one's ours: a chance to be kids in a playground again. The kicker: it's pro-bono and self-financed, so the budget is laughable. Hell of a pitch, eh. What's actually on the table: a top-notch production and post crew, a designed festival short, full credit, finished material for your reel, plus two night shoots over Labor Day weekend (Sept 4–6), locked around everyone's availability.

footer.text:
